svg.title: Electron spectrum
svg.desc: Nine measured xenon lines and a small center glow. The angular brightness of each ring follows its CPBASEX Legendre coefficients.
svg.metadata: Angular profiles from betas10.txt, aligned to energy_l10.txt at the local maxima of energy_spec_l10.txt. Each core uses I(theta) = 1 + sum(beta_l * P_l(cos(theta))) for l = 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, divided by the maximum of that line's angular profile. Theta is measured from vertical. Radii use the previously refined peak positions.
